scope: stage6 minimal teaching calibrated two-view SfM; no PnP, incremental registration, BA, new benchmark or stage7
intrinsics_protocol: known distortion-free K per image, explicitly supplied calibration input; DTU pose/scale/reference points never used in reconstruction
preprocessing: reuse fixed local stage3 Pillow bilinear 800x600 images and zero-based pixel-center affine A; K_processed=A*K_original
normalized_threshold_rule: pixel threshold divided by mean fx/fy across both images; exact K inverse includes skew
homography_gate: conservative ambiguity warning/rejection, not proof of planarity or rotation
pose_hypotheses: decomposeEssentialMat, enumerate (R1,+t),(R1,-t),(R2,+t),(R2,-t); choose most finite dual-positive E inliers, tie lower median max-view reprojection
triangulation: explicit batched DLT SVD; save all candidate points/depths/angles/errors/masks; filter dual-positive, sufficient angle, both-view reprojection
scale: camera1 I/0; camera2 world-to-camera R/t with norm(t)=1; no metric scale recovery
device: CPU OpenCV SIFT/RANSAC and NumPy SVD; no model load or GPU allocation
